## trie setup now installs a PR digest workflow into every project:… — 2026-07-25 (parent 76f9ee4ef8c1)

Adds `trie/workflow_install.py` with three public symbols: `render_triediff_workflow` renders the `triediff-comment.yml` GitHub Actions workflow YAML with `diffs_dir` and `WORKFLOW_MARKER` baked in; `WorkflowInstallResult` is a frozen dataclass carrying `action`, `path`, and `note`; `install_triediff_workflow` idempotently writes the workflow to `.github/workflows/triediff-comment.yml`, returning `created`/`updated`/`unchanged`/`skipped`/`error`. Files lacking `WORKFLOW_MARKER` on line 1 are treated as user-owned and never modified; directories without `.git` are skipped; `dry_run=True` reports without writing
